text:
incident-bot: AUTOPAGER — us-east-az4 serving plane detecting sustained 5xx spike (>3% over 5m). error-rate: 6.8%. PagerDuty PD-2026 created and notified @Jamie M. (oncall) and @Sanjay G. (backup). runbook: https://intra.redwood/runbooks/region-fallback :rotating_light:

Jamie M.: ack — I'm awake and looking. grabbing logs and top traces now. anyone see if this is model-shard specific or whole az?

Sanjay G.: joining. KV cache eviction rate jumped — evict/sec ~4x baseline. looks like prefix cache thrash on several shards.

Jamie M.: console: front-proxy queue depth rising, 95p latency ~450ms+, 5xx mainly 502/504 from backend connection resets.

Lia K.: infra check — autoscaler failed to provision extra GPU heads in az4 due to a quota exhaustion error from cloud (quota=0 free gpus). we can divert traffic to az3 as a fallback.

Jamie M.: ok let's divert incrementally. preparing routing divert. command I use (internal):
```
POST https://controlplane.internal/v1/routing/divert
{ "source_region": "us-east-az4", "target_region": "us-east-az3", "percent": 20 }
```

incident-bot: routing-divert job submitted id=rd-xyz123, initial rollout 20% applied. will report status.

Matt R.: applying quick protection: rate-limit batch queue and short-circuit some long tails. patch: set disable_batch_queue=true for shard t2 to reduce backend pressure.

ops-runner: customer-impact snapshot: approx 14% of us-east requests affected. top impacted tenants: Acme Inc., Shoply. embedding endpoints have highest error fraction. sending customer comms draft to cs: "We're seeing elevated errors in us-east-az4; traffic is being diverted; mitigation underway."

Sanjay G.: PD note: Jamie acknowledged. If no clear recovery in 10m escalate PD to SEV2.

incident-bot: rd-xyz123 status -> 20% -> 50% applied -> 100% applied (timestamped). traffic now fully routed away from az4.

Jamie M.: update: after full diversion error-rate dropped to ~0.9% in affected paths. tail latency still slightly elevated. keeping monitoring feeds on. will hand over to Sanjay in 10m for post-divert stabilization.

Sanjay G.: taking over. I'll run kvcache diag and watch eviction metrics. Jamie, please handoff ticket details when you free.

incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-2026 status changed: acknowledged by Jamie M.; after customer SLA hits PD escalation to SEV2 requested by oncall.

Matt R.: interim mitigation applied: kvcache size bump (kvcache.max_entries += 30%) and aggressive TTL enforcement on ephemeral keys. monitoring for OOM; rolling back if memory climbs.

Lia K.: cloud ops ticket opened for GPU quota bump in az4 (REQ-7731). ETA quoted ~45m. if quota not granted we'll keep fallback active until pool healthy.

ops-runner: ops estimate: keep fallback active 1h, then test bleed-back in small increments (10% steps) while watching 5xx rate and queue depth. drafting runbook notes for postmortem.

Jamie M.: creating incident tracking ticket INC-2026-az4 with timeline + playbook references. will include graphs and affected customer list.

Sanjay G.: note for postmortem: investigate autoscaler retry logic on quota errors (shouldn't mark capacity as healthy when provisioning fails). also look into prefix cache eviction pattern.

incident-bot: automated summary posted to #incidents-feed and PD, stakeholders notified.

ops-runner: final update before handoff: error-rate stable ~0.8%, 95p latency trending down. leaving monitoring on, will escalate if metrics regress. handing to Sanjay for stabilization window.

Sanjay G.: taking it from here. thanks Jamie. will call for handback when we see 30m of stable metrics.

incident-bot: Incident PD-2026 moved to status: monitoring. last action at 3467004521.

(threads for follow-up: postmortem + config fixes; runbook link again: https://intra.redwood/runbooks/region-fallback)
